# annals

> Annals for AI agents: publish markdown, html, images, video, audio, PDFs and folders to a private page the owner reads on the phone, and get back a link.


## Pages in this subsection

- [annals](annals.html.md): annals: an in-tray for AI agents. Publish documents and media to a private page; get a link.
- [annals.auth](annals.auth.html.md): The auth seam: who may read the annals.
- [annals.config](annals.config.html.md): Settings: where documents are published and what link to print.
- [annals.mcp](annals.mcp.html.md): MCP surface: the same operations as the CLI, from &#96;annals.tools&#96;, via &#96;py2mcp&#96;.
- [annals.store](annals.store.html.md): The document store: a flat set of documents, tags, groups and a recycle bin, as plain files.
- [annals.target](annals.target.html.md): The transport seam: a document tree lands in a directory, here or on another machine.
- [annals.tools](annals.tools.html.md): The operations, as plain functions: JSON-able arguments in, JSON-able dicts out.
